name: Nekomimi ni Hibiku Zetsubou
source:
Main character happens to get a cat band. When his sister wears it, she turns into a real cat. Protagonist is head over heels into nekophilia, so he can't keep his sanity when sister or her best friend take cat form.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公偶然得到一只猫耳发箍。妹妹戴上后，竟然变成了一只真正的猫。主人公有着强烈的恋猫癖，所以每当妹妹或她的挚友化身为猫，他便再也无法保持理智。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
